messages.content: You are planning a sequence of ordinary, mundane public social-media posts for one fictional author. You do not write the posts; you invent the concrete, small, specific everyday occasions behind them. Output strict JSON only.

Author profile:
- płeć gramatyczna: kobieta (formy żeńskie)
- zajęcie i rytm dnia: Studiuje filologię w Białymstoku i pilnuje recepcji w akademiku; pisze późnym wieczorem.
- zainteresowania: podcasty o języku, zakładki do książek, gry karciane
- lokalny punkt odniesienia: ławka przy ulicy Akademickiej w Białymstoku
- aktualna sytuacja życiowa: Przygotowuje prezentację na zajęcia i urządza pokój po przeprowadzce.
- sposób pisania: zdania: long run-on; interpunkcja: ellipsis everywhere; wielkie litery: mostly standard, lowercase starts; literówki: rare; skróty: some (nwm, jj, bd, wgl); emoji: frequent
- tik językowy: zaczyna od „w sumie to”

For each of the 18 topic prompts below, invent ONE concrete, specific, small occasion from this person's life that would make them post (not a generic statement about the topic: a particular thing that happened, with at most one small detail a real person would mention - sometimes a product name, sometimes a number or price, sometimes a place, occasionally a time; many occasions need no such detail at all). Vary mood (bored, amused, tired, pleased, mildly annoyed, neutral, curious), vary how the post starts (mid-thought, a question, a one-word reaction, a fact, a quote of what someone said), and decide whether the verbal tic appears (at most in a third of posts). Occasions must not involve conflict with identifiable people, politics, crime, security, violence, or protected characteristics.

Topic prompts:
1. zakupy i ceny - nowe buty / kurtka (lunch break, Monday)
2. dzieci i rodzina - dziadkowie, telefon (early morning, Wednesday)
3. drobne narzekanie na usługi - infolinia, oczekiwanie (lunch break, Tuesday)
4. pogoda - ładny wieczór, zachód słońca (evening, Tuesday)
5. praca i grafik - spotkanie albo szkolenie w pracy (lunch break, Saturday)
6. pogoda - zmiana pogody vs plany (early morning, Wednesday)
7. remont i dom - meble do złożenia (morning commute, Wednesday)
8. zakupy i ceny - koszyk w aplikacji, zniżki (late night, Tuesday)
9. jedzenie i gotowanie - nieudane ciasto / danie (evening, Sunday)
10. dzieci i rodzina - urodziny, prezent (late night, Wednesday)
11. dzieci i rodzina - zebranie w szkole (lunch break, Thursday)
12. remont i dom - ogródek, balkon, rośliny (late morning, Monday)
13. dzieci i rodzina - pierwsze słowa / pierwsza jazda rowerem (early morning, Tuesday)
14. komunikacja i dojazdy - korek na obwodnicy / w centrum (afternoon, Wednesday)
15. technologia i sprzęt - padła bateria / ładowarka (late night, Sunday)
16. remont i dom - sąsiedzi wiercą (łagodnie) (afternoon, Tuesday)
17. gry i seriale - stream ulubionego streamera (afternoon, Wednesday)
18. pogoda - nagły deszcz (late morning, Tuesday)

Return a JSON array of 18 objects, in order, each with:
- "occasion": one or two sentences in Polish, concrete
- "mood": one word in English
- "opener": one of "mid-thought", "question", "one-word reaction", "plain fact", "reported speech", "complaint", "list of two things"
- "length_words": integer between 8 and 50, varied across the set (some very short)
- "tic_fires": true or false
